耳边忽然传来一道讥嘲之声，只见南山宗一位穿着蓝袍的青年长老正上下打量着他，一副欣赏异类的表情：“啧啧，灵仙宗真是好混啊，筑基期修为竟然都能当长老！”
这青年长老声音明显有意加大，在场之人都听到了，纷纷侧目。
“奇葩长老？就是那位自己把自己修炼到走火入魔，修为倒退的？”
“竟然是他，我前几天才听我灵仙宗的朋友谈及过！”
“都修为跌落了，他怎么还敢带弟子来这两宗交流会呀？”
灵仙宗众长老见状都是面色一沉，知道南山宗这青年长老是故意找茬，但这事又无法反驳。
仿佛在说，你一个人直接拉低了我们的档次！
张云翻了个白眼，不过听着场中议论微微摇头。
果然哪个世界都一样，八卦是传播最快的！
瞥了眼开口的南山宗青年长老，没有生气，只是淡淡问道：“这位长老怎么称呼？”
青年长老闻言，不屑一笑：“本长老可没兴趣……”
“原来阁下叫本长老呀，这姓氏倒是少见！”
没等对方说完，张云就一副‘我懂了’的模样道。
“你胡说什么，本长……我何时说我叫本长老了？我乃南山宗八长老，邱略！”
邱略立马意识过来自己被骗出名字，不由大恼。
“邱略，求虐……啧啧，这名字取的，比本长老还别致！”

张云微笑：“这位‘求虐’长老，你既认识我，不知可有兴趣跟我打个赌呢？”
“两宗交流会马上开始，就赌赌我们在这两宗交流会上的成绩吧！”
张云笑吟吟，道：“我和你带领各自弟子的最终成绩，谁更好，就算谁赢。输者给对方一万灵石，如何？”
围观之人都是一脸错愕看向张云，这奇葩长老疯了吧？跟一位金丹期长老打赌，还赌一万灵石？这是嫌灵石太多要送点不成？
倒是灵仙宗众长老听到这个数字，有些古怪看了眼张云。
身为当事人的邱略稍稍一愣后也反应过来，一脸诧异看向张云。
邱略见状哼了声，冷笑开口：“你想送灵石，那本长老收着便是。”

"You are the famous and strange elder of Lingxian Sect, right?"
Suddenly, a sarcastic voice came to his ears, and he saw a young elder from the Nanshan Sect wearing a blue robe looking him up and down, with an admiring expression: "Tsk, tsk, the Lingxian Sect is really easy to mess around with. You can even become an elder at the foundation stage!"
The young elder's voice was obviously louder on purpose, and everyone present heard it and looked sideways.
"The weird elder? Is he the one who cultivated himself to the point of going crazy and regressing in cultivation?"
"It turned out to be him. I just heard my friends from the Lingxian Sect talk about it a few days ago!"
"How can he still dare to bring his disciples to these two sect exchange meetings when his cultivation level has declined?"
The expressions of all the elders of Lingxian Sect darkened when they saw this. They knew that the young elder of Nanshan Sect was deliberately looking for trouble, but they could not refute this.
It seems to be saying, you alone have directly lowered our standards!
Zhang Yun rolled his eyes, but shook his head slightly as he listened to the discussion.
Sure enough, it’s the same in every world, gossip spreads the fastest!
He glanced at the young elder of Nanshan Sect who spoke. He was not angry and just asked lightly: "What is the name of this elder?"
Hearing this, the young elder smiled disdainfully: "I am not interested..."
"It turns out that your Excellency is called Elder. This surname is quite rare!"
Before the other party had finished speaking, Zhang Yun said with an "I understand" look.
"What nonsense are you talking about, my elder... When did I say that my name is elder? I am the eighth elder of the Nanshan Sect, Qiu Lue!"
Qiu Lue immediately realized that his name had been deceived, and he couldn't help but feel annoyed.
"Qiu Lue, please forgive me... tsk tsk, this name is even more unique than this elder!"
Zhang Yun smiled: "This elder of 'Qiu Abuse', since you know me, are you interested in making a bet with me?"
"The two exchange meetings will start soon. Let's bet on our results in these two exchange meetings!"
Zhang Yun smiled and said: "The final result of leading our respective disciples between you and me is better, whoever wins. How about the loser giving the other party 10,000 spirit stones?"
The onlookers all looked at Zhang Yun in astonishment. Is this strange elder crazy? A bet with a golden elixir stage elder and a bet of 10,000 spirit stones? Is it because you think there are too many spiritual stones and you want to give some away?
However, when the elders of Lingxian Sect heard this number, they looked at Zhang Yun strangely.
As the person involved, Qiu Wei reacted after being stunned for a moment and looked at Zhang Yun with a surprised look on his face.
Qiu Lue snorted when he saw this, and said with a sneer: "If you want to give the spirit stone as a gift, the elder can just keep it."
As he said something that came to his mind, he glanced at Zhang Yun contemptuously: "It's only ten thousand spirit stones. I'm a little worried that I won't be able to get it during this foundation building period. You won't just talk about it and cheat afterwards, right?"
